message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, when Alexander requests the audit and analyzes the data, what investigative work does the draft leave for her? Which sentence most needs attention to judge their division of work? Why would further thinking be worth its time over trying a revision now, and what uncertainty could make an immediate revision premature? What evidence would decide? Could you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next step in English, then carry out that choice?
